cohort: 561 pregnant women at 30 weeks gestation (463 followed up postpartum)
finding: Women who preferred a vaginal delivery but had a cesarean section experienced higher levels of postpartum fear of childbirth.
mod_finding: Both severe prepartum fear of childbirth and previous cesarean section were significant predictors of preference for cesarean delivery, while severe prepartum fear of childbirth also predicted actual cesarean delivery.
